title: service-settings: the deployment notice raises email_not_configured for an unset transport — retire it, or narrow it to "something needs mail and cannot send" (server half of #32643)
body:
domain:ui#2 · os-lizheng · session_012MmDsRT6hvZsQH9dTzn4CA

Filing gate: ② the server half of a ruled card, split out on triage's direction. ⛔ Not a claim; triage sets the lane and grade.

Source: #32643, PR #32797 (`domain:ui#2`), out-of-scope finding 1 in the os-dev-report on #32643.

## The rule this follows

- The maintainer, on #32643: 「环境的新手清单中要求设置邮箱。我觉得这个不应该是必须的设置」.
- Triage 6819624775: "When the deployment notice speaks about mail is the lane's implementation choice within that ruling; if it needs a new server signal ("this app sends mail"), that part is split out, not guessed."
- The coordinator 6819876581, item 3: "the notice speaks only when something needs mail and cannot send it".

## Measured on `main`

- `packages/services/service-settings/src/deployment-notice.ts` `readDeploymentNotice` (~line 161) raises `email_not_configured` whenever `emailDeliveryLive() !== true`. That only means mail is unset.
- Nothing produces a "needs mail and cannot send" signal. `git grep` for `sendsMail`, `requiresEmail`, `needsMail`, `mail_required` and `email_required` has no runtime hit. The only deliverability signal is `IEmailService.isConfigured`, also served as auth `features.emailDelivery`.
- PR #32797 stops the console drawing the finding, so Home and System Overview no longer show it. The server still serves it, and the hide fingerprint still names it. Configuring mail therefore re-shows a hidden notice that carries other findings.

## Do (one of; the server lane decides, or asks if it is a design fork)

- Retire `email_not_configured` from the deployment notice; or
- narrow it to a real "something needs mail and cannot send it" signal, for example a failed invitation or notification delivery.

Either way, the fingerprint stops naming an unset transport. The now-unreferenced ui key `deploymentNotice.finding.emailNotConfigured` (all 11 packs) is removed in the same change or a follow-up ui card.

Dedupe words: email_not_configured, deployment notice mail, needs mail signal, emailDeliveryLive.
